title: Complete nested palace roof plan
owner_correction: Higher wards centrally nested; terraces step down and outward; show whole palace with all inventoried tower places, stairs and wings
prompt:
Create ONE complete architectural ROOF PLAN SKETCH of the original princess palace viewed EXACTLY FROM ABOVE, looking vertically down. Title PAL-ROOF-PLAN-001 — Complete nested palace roof plan. No side sections, no elevation panels, no isometric camera, no upright tower shafts, no vertical front-facing windows. The supplied original FRONT gives tower identity, colors and carved architectural vocabulary, not a plan to copy. Draw actual connected roof footprints, radial dome crowns, chapel roof ridges, spire crown/star footprints, roof gardens, wall thickness, parapets, courtyards and stairs, fully framed on warm ivory paper in fine ink and restrained rose/ivory marble watercolor, gold trim, plum/indigo crowns, small blue water features.
CRITICAL correction: terraces STEP DOWN AND OUTWARD FROM A CENTRAL HEART. L4 is the SMALL CENTRAL highest roof court, enclosed by L3, then L2, then the LARGE lowest L1 OUTER BASE. Every lower layer continues around the higher layer on WEST,EAST,NORTH and its appropriate SOUTH front. Do not put L4 at the north/top edge of a long upward staircase strip; do not accumulate all high wings at the back. Colour/label nested exposed roof bands L1=60,L2=160,L3=230,L4=300 GRID m. Heights stay60,160,230,300; descending from inner to outer is300→230→160→60. NORTH/REAR at page TOP; SOUTH/FRONT at BOTTOM; WEST LEFT,EAST RIGHT.
WORKING PLAN frame, deliberately PROPOSED:800 grid m wide and680 deep, X=-400..400, Y=-150..530, using rounded/chamfered main contours with asymmetric connected wing projections. L1 outside footprint X±400,Y-150..530. L2 inside X±300,Y0..455. L3 inside X±200,Y60..380. L4 central X±100,Y120..305. Keep these contours NESTED, no clipped upper island touching outer rear wall. L4 centre Y212.5 is near overall centre190, not pushed to extreme rear. These overall dimensions and L4 frontY120 are proposed, not previously confirmed exact measurements. Main side wall-face gaps100 between every successive level; rear gaps75. Draw SIDE dimension arrows horizontally EAST-WEST across contour faces, and REAR arrows vertically NORTH-SOUTH between rear contour faces. Never switch those arrow axes. You may place clean extension lines outside drawing. Do not force the100 or75 onto unconfirmed front gaps.
SOUTH arrival: SINGLE connected five-arch gate-wall footprint at Y0 with G1,G2,G3,G4,G5, four glazed bays and centreG3 entrance, not five standalone gate blocks. Preserve original gate asymmetry and original source front tower anchors. Stair foot Y-150 Z0; BOTH dry stair strips flank the separate blue CENTRAL WET CASCADE, climbing to Y-75 Z60. Keep clear75 m L1 roof terrace from stair topY-75 to gateY0. Total front-wall-to-gate150. L2→L3 front60; L3→L4 front60 here is PROPOSED. Do not press stair top against gate. All decorative rails and landings join continuous walls.
Show ALL33 inventoried tower-footprint marks from the coordinate list appended below, with small legible full placement IDs or T01–T33 next to them. Tower X order follows the original front, do not mirror west/east, do not drag all towers onto the highest contour, and do not create new dominant towers at layer corners. Main WEST broad onion pavilionT05 is left-of-centre aroundX-175,Y145, distinct large bulbous radial crown. Royal needleT12 and attached small turret marksT13/T14 are near centreX-30,Y205 within highest royal COURTYARD, not at the north edge. EAST belvedereT22 is aroundX170,Y45 toward front; tall EAST chapel-spire clusterT24,T25,T26 remains on the eastern attached lower wing aroundX250–310,Y205–240, not mirrored onto west. Original terminal onionsT02/T27 stay south corners. Minor towers connect to the main wall, curved projections, ward wings or parent turret cluster; not random detached circles across gardens. Attached childrenT13,T14,T21 join parents, not freestanding extra towers. Roofs shown in TRUE PLAN as concentric/ribbed dome discs and chapel polygons, never side-view domes. Tiny decorative pinnacles may appear at source-family parapets but must not replace numbered tower footprints.
Continuous irregular palace wards: soft angled and semihexagonal/circular projections, recessed garden bays, attached secondary wings, no row of separate boxes. Add the four roof courts in the appended list; small pools, lotus fountains, benches, flower beds, lamps and walking paths use existing palette/detail families. Royal tower footprint sits within central roof court. West garden court and eastern chapel court retain asymmetric shape. Stairs and roof paths connect every pair of adjacent tiers at sides and rear; dry access remains to centreG3. Avoid new large bridges, gigantic empty platforms, enormous replacement fountains and a front facade transplanted to rear.
Print geographic compass, seven major tower-name callouts, numbered secondary tower marks, stair route keys and four level roof heights. Put short footer: CENTRE HIGH → OUTER LOW / MAIN WALL GAPS100 SIDE,75 REAR / DEPTHS AND EXTRA FRONT SETBACK PROPOSED / ORIGINAL GEN-37 FRONT CONTROLS. One coherent complete roof plan, enough detail to read all towers, stairs, wings and courts, not merely an empty contour diagram. True overhead roof silhouettes and plan geometry are essential.
